title: Canary actual del request lane de frontier-pressure
mission: Verify the already-implemented append-only frontier-pressure request lane against one exact current main commit without using workflow_dispatch. Capture the chosen 40-hex source SHA, CREATE exactly one request file under the binding protocol, prove the triggered workflow checks out that exact SHA, and persist run/job/artifact evidence. This is canary evidence only and must not promote Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority.
definition_of_done: Execution chooses and records one exact 40-hex main source SHA before creating the request.
Exactly one binding prometeo.frontier-pressure-request/v1 request is created for that SHA using the durable request protocol; direct workflow_dispatch is not used.
The resulting Frontier Pressure Exact Snapshot workflow resolves the request and proves checked-out HEAD equals the requested SHA.
Run/job status and any produced artifact identifiers/digests are persisted as durable evidence; a regression failure is reported as evidence rather than rewritten as success.
The canary leaves the request transport usable by generic authorized /wc workers and promotes no product authority.
